rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose neutral choice for a person or thing showing a lot of feeling.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 gam2 cing4

rows.note: Choose this when someone is being ruled by feelings or is easily affected and may react irrationally.

example.english: Don't be so emotional; calm down first.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁情緒化，先冷靜吓。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cing4 seoi5 faa3 sin1 laang5 zing6 haa5

rows.note: Use this when someone is deeply moved and close to tears.

example.english: I was really emotional after reading the letter.
example.traditional: 我睇完封信，真係好感動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 jyun4 fung1 seon3 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a speech, story, film, or event that arouses strong feelings in people.

example.english: The ending of this film is really emotional.
example.traditional: 呢套戲個結局真係好感人。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 go3 git3 guk6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 jan4
